output.question: What is the current population of Tokyo?

sources.title: Tokyo Third in UN Ranking of Global Megacities at 33.4 Million

output.findings:
The population of Tokyo varies significantly depending on whether the scope is the city proper (Tokyo Metropolis) or the Greater Tokyo Area.

As of 2025, the population of Tokyo Metropolis (the city proper) is estimated to be over 14 million residents.

The Greater Tokyo Area, which includes the surrounding prefectures and constitutes one of the world's largest metropolitan regions, has an estimated population of approximately 33.4 million people as of 2025.
